[2] AR: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ فَمِنكُمْ كَافِرٌۭ وَمِنكُم مُّؤْمِنٌۭ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ EN: It is He who created you, and among you is the disbeliever, and among you is the believer.
And Allah dispensed [with them]; and Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy.

folded.id: and allah|has|with him a great reward
folded.subject: and Allah

spans.text: [15] AR: إِنَّمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَأَوْلَٰدُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌۭ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌۭ EN: Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and Allah has with Him a great reward.

folded.id: and allah|is|acquainted with what you do
folded.subject: And Allah

spans.text: And Allah is Acquainted with what you do.

folded.id: and allah|is|free of need and praiseworthy
folded.subject: and Allah

spans.text: And Allah dispensed [with them]; and Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy.

folded.id: and allah|is|knowing of that within the breasts
folded.subject: And Allah
folded.object: Knowing of that within the breasts

spans.text: And Allah is Knowing of that within the breasts.
And Allah is Most Appreciative and Forbearing.
and disbelieved and turned away.
To Him belongs dominion, and to Him belongs [all] praise, and He is over all things competent.
And Allah is Knowing of all things.
So they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment.

folded.id: and whoever|is|protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful
folded.subject: And whoever
folded.object: protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful

spans.text: And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.

[10] AR: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ EN: But the ones who disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of the Fire, abiding eternally therein; and wretched is the destination.
So they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment.
[11] AR: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُۥ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ EN: No disaster strikes except by permission of Allah.

folded.id: day he|will|assemble you for the day of assembly - that is the day of deprivation
folded.subject: Day He
folded.object: assemble you for the Day of Assembly - that is the Day of Deprivation

spans.text: [9] AR: يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُكُمْ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْجَمْعِ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلتَّغَابُنِ ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًۭا يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ EN: The Day He will assemble you for the Day of Assembly - that is the Day of Deprivation.
[17] AR: إِن تُقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا يُضَٰعِفْهُ لَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ EN: If you loan Allah a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you.

folded.id: fear allah|as|much as you are able and listen and obey and spend [in the way of allah]
folded.subject: fear Allah
folded.object: much as you are able and listen and obey and spend [in the way of Allah]

spans.text: [16] AR: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ خَيْرًۭا لِّأَنفُسِكُمْ ۗ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ EN: So fear Allah as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend [in the way of Allah]; it is better for your selves.

folded.id: he|created|the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms
folded.subject: He
folded.object: the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms

spans.text: [3] AR: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ EN: He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to Him is the [final] destination.

folded.id: he|knows|what is within the heavens and earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare
folded.subject: He
folded.object: what is within the heavens and earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare

spans.text: [4] AR: يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ EN: He knows what is within the heavens and earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare.

[16] AR: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ خَيْرًۭا لِّأَنفُسِكُمْ ۗ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ EN: So fear Allah as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend [in the way of Allah]; it is better for your selves.

[2] AR: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ فَمِنكُمْ كَافِرٌۭ وَمِنكُم مُّؤْمِنٌۭ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ EN: It is He who created you, and among you is the disbeliever, and among you is the believer.
[18] AR: عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ EN: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
[17] AR: إِن تُقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا يُضَٰعِفْهُ لَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ EN: If you loan Allah a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you.

[14] AR: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُمْ وَأَوْلَٰدِكُمْ عَدُوًّۭا لَّكُمْ فَٱحْذَرُوهُمْ ۚ وَإِن تَعْفُوا۟ وَتَصْفَحُوا۟ وَتَغْفِرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ EN: O you who have believed, indeed, among your wives and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them.

[12] AR: وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ ۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ EN: And obey Allah and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon Our Messenger is only [the duty of] clear notification.

folded.id: our messenger|is|only [the duty of] clear notification
folded.subject: Our Messenger

spans.text: [12] AR: وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ ۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ EN: And obey Allah and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon Our Messenger is only [the duty of] clear notification.

[6] AR: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُۥ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرٌۭ يَهْدُونَنَا فَكَفَرُوا۟ وَتَوَلَّوا۟ ۚ وَّٱسْتَغْنَى ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ EN: That is because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences, but they said, "Shall human beings guide us?"

folded.id: so believe|in|allah and his messenger and the qur'an which we have sent down
folded.subject: So believe
folded.object: Allah and His Messenger and the Qur'an which We have sent down

spans.text: [8] AR: فَـَٔامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَٱلنُّورِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلْنَا ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ EN: So believe in Allah and His Messenger and the Qur'an which We have sent down.
And whoever believes in Allah and does righteousness - He will remove from him his misdeeds and admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever.
And whoever believes in Allah - He will guide his heart.

[14] AR: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُمْ وَأَوْلَٰدِكُمْ عَدُوًّۭا لَّكُمْ فَٱحْذَرُوهُمْ ۚ وَإِن تَعْفُوا۟ وَتَصْفَحُوا۟ وَتَغْفِرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ EN: O you who have believed, indeed, among your wives and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them.

folded.id: that|is|because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences
folded.subject: That
folded.object: because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences

spans.text: [6] AR: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُۥ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرٌۭ يَهْدُونَنَا فَكَفَرُوا۟ وَتَوَلَّوا۟ ۚ وَّٱسْتَغْنَى ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ EN: That is because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences, but they said, "Shall human beings guide us?"
That is the great attainment.
[18] AR: عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ EN: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
[5] AR: أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ فَذَاقُوا۟ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ EN: Has there not come to you the news of those who disbelieved before?

folded.id: the ones|who|disbelieved and denied our verses - those are the companions of the fire
folded.subject: the ones
folded.object: disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of the Fire

spans.text: [10] AR: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ EN: But the ones who disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of the Fire, abiding eternally therein; and wretched is the destination.
[13] AR: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ EN: Allah - there is no deity except Him.

folded.id: those|who|disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected
folded.subject: Those
folded.object: disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected

spans.text: [7] AR: زَعَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَن لَّن يُبْعَثُوا۟ ۚ قُلْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّى لَتُبْعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُنَبَّؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلْتُمْ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌۭ EN: Those who disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected.

[3] AR: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ EN: He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to Him is the [final] destination.
And upon Allah let the believers rely.

folded.id: whatever is|in|the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting allah
folded.subject: Whatever is
folded.object: the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allah

spans.text: [1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ EN: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allah.
And whoever believes in Allah and does righteousness - He will remove from him his misdeeds and admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever.

folded.id: you pardon|and|overlook and forgive - then indeed
folded.subject: you pardon

spans.text: But if you pardon and overlook and forgive - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
Say, "Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected; then you will surely be informed of what you did.

folded.id: your wives|and|your children are enemies to you
folded.subject: your wives
folded.object: your children are enemies to you

spans.text: [14] AR: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُمْ وَأَوْلَٰدِكُمْ عَدُوًّۭا لَّكُمْ فَٱحْذَرُوهُمْ ۚ وَإِن تَعْفُوا۟ وَتَصْفَحُوا۟ وَتَغْفِرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ EN: O you who have believed, indeed, among your wives and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them.
[15] AR: إِنَّمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَأَوْلَٰدُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌۭ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌۭ EN: Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and Allah has with Him a great reward.
